column18: SpiNNaker2 up to 32x lower energy than GTX 1650 GPU baseline for SNN models; no ANN comparison.
LSM-based SNN: at least 14.6% better accuracy than SOTA approaches with 40% of their power; up to 7-DoF manipulators.
Energy efficiency 2.47x and 3.30x over representative ANNs on Cityscapes and TT100K; mAP +10.4% and +12.0% over prior SNN.
CSNN estimated energy 4.8% and FLOPs 25% of similar CNN; 0.225 µJ per inference; accuracy 99.90% on GTSRB.
Spiking Spatiotemporal Transformer needs 19.1% FLOPs and 3.6% energy of SOTA ANN-based methods for event-based 3D pose tracking.
Pruned SNN latency rises with activity regularization strength; modified loss term fixes this and improves computational load; no figures.
IMP on fully connected networks increases non-Gaussianity of pre-activations, producing local receptive fields; mechanistic analysis, no efficiency figures.
Runtime benchmarking: MLP/CNN gain from GPU HPC acceleration; sparse RLS SNN scales non-monotonically, baseline faster at small to mid sizes.
Hybrid CNN-LSTM plus SNN: accuracy 91.2%, F1 0.90, inference energy 2.1 mJ, lower than other effective models.
Hybrid ANN-SNN layer configurations cut energy up to 2.45x at ANN baseline accuracy on CIFAR-10 and GSC V2.
Variable spiking GNNs claim sparse communication and energy efficiency; compared with vanilla GNNs on regression performance only.
Compiler for ANN-SNN hybrid PIM accelerators; 2.48x latency and 2.74x energy gains over SOTA techniques, no explicit ANN baseline.
Hybrid ANN-SNN training and inference accelerator; accuracy 99.65% on ANN MNIST and 99.34% on SNN N-MNIST; no efficiency metric.
Hypernetwork generates semi-binary masks yielding task-specific LTH subnetworks for continual learning; no efficiency figures.
Spiking vision transformer for image aesthetic assessment; energy reduction claimed without comparator or figures.
CLSM compared with CNNs and Transformers on accuracy and efficiency; claims energy efficiency, no efficiency figures in abstract.
UAV intrusion detection, 28 ms and 0.25 J per inference; best trade-off claimed without explicit ANN comparison.
RRAM crossbar SNN MNIST inference power 243 nW with quantization, 222 nW with quantization and pruning; array-level model estimate.
Sparse associative memory SNN with neurogenesis; topology optimization raises memory capacity over 10^4x; no efficiency metric or ANN comparison.
Two-stage dynamic sparse training for deep SNNs: PQ-index-based adaptive rewiring ratio; matches SNN accuracy with better compression; no figures.
Over 4,000x less energy than existing deep learning approaches on DVSCLEAN; SNR up to 31.13 dB, F1 0.9847.
Converted SNNs show lower energy than conventional ANNs; no figures in abstract; local threshold balancing conversion.
SpikeYOLO on Gen1: mAP@50 67.2%, +2.5% over ANN with equivalent architecture, energy efficiency 5.7x; COCO 66.2% mAP@50.
IF-NN has better computational time than RNN on each dataset (no figures); MAPE 65.9-74.3% better than second-best models.
Roadmap review of model compression and sparsity (pruning, quantization, distillation, LoRA) for Gen AI on IoT; no quantitative results.
